name: Release v3.8.0
body:

* feat: add `Ctrl+Shift+U` shortcut to update apps by @ArqamQazi in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/170
* fix: stop leaking stale release tags to manual and zsync upgrades, and resolve pinned zsync tags directly. Fixes #166 (1c564e8)
* fix: skip sub-desktop entries that duplicate the root entry by content signature. Fixes #172 (c07b5df)
* feat: create portable home folder for standalone runs (9d013f7)
* feat: make missing FUSE warning banner dismissiable (8825b5e)
* fix: resolve relative CLI paths in remote invocations and never overwrite foreign bin symlinks. Fixes #175 (bb9937b)
* feat: use appimg install protocol by @xlc-dev in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/173
* feat: Add support for one-click web installs via appmgr:// links (71ac7ad)
* fix: Skip runtime helper binaries when installing multi-desktop AppImages. Fixes #156 (e966157)
* fix: Simplify empty-state hints and remove import buttons. Fixes #154 confusion (c91bfdf)
* fix: Keep UI responsive while stopping background daemon during migration (eb60c17)
* fix: Migrate extra desktop files and bin symlinks for multi-component AppImages (b938bf0)
* docs: Update AppHub link by @xlc-dev in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/171


### Translations
* French translation by @denisrennes in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/155
* Update Spanish translation by @haggen88 in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/167


## New Contributors

name: Release v3.6.3
body:
## What's changed

* **feat**. Add app list sorting options and update UI components for sorting functionality. Fixes #121 (bc67190)
* Implement support for multi-component AppImages by extracting and managing additional desktop entries, icons, and symlinks during installation and uninstallation. Fixes #106 (9797604)
* Refactor background daemon termination to use SIGTERM for graceful shutdown, with fallback to SIGKILL if necessary. Improve signal handling for clean exit on stop requests. Fixes #114 (971f838)

body:
## What's Changed

Hi guys. This is a feature rich update. Enjoy! Hopefully it won't introduce too many bugs.

### New Features
* Refactor detailed window with **separate pages for advanced settings and update details**. Creates a cleaner details window look and anticipates next big feature implementation (bfbe5ca)
* Add option to **disable individual app** automatic **updates** (bfbe5ca)
* Add **Nix package** and **flake integration** by @finettt in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/97
* Add support for **portable .home and .config** folders in AppManager. Solves #94 (a9b634e)
* Add **update** and **update-all** CLI **commands** to manage installed AppImages. Solves #98 (a594e27)
* Add filename sanitization option to **preserve .AppImage extension** and replace spaces with underscores. Solves #95 (70b188b)

### Bug fixes
* Improve Import wizard. Fix bug where it would import everything from folder without any guards creating duplicates and wrong ARCH files (a57f855)
* Refactor: remove obsolete FUSE detection logic and update dependencies. Use `gmodule` instead (dbc168d)

### Translations
* Update Spanish translation by @haggen88 in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/101

## New Contributors
* @finettt made their first contribution in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/97
* @haggen88 made their first contribution in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/101

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/compare/v3.5.2...v3.6.0

The previous updates (v3.5.0 and v3.5.1) introduced an issue #91 in the zsync update flow, resulting in a "file name too long" error. Unfortunately, this also affects the AppManager self-update functionality. **To update AppManager, please download and install this version manually**

body:
## What's Changed

* **Anylinux sharun packaging** by @kem-a in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/16  Fixes #13 #9 #10 #11. Now you can run this app on your bookworm
* Cookie for nondrager club by @kem-a in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/17. Omg, no more drag-n-drop to install an app :)

* @PiterWeb made their first contribution in https://github.com/kem-a/AppManager/pull/12

## Special thanks to [package forge](https://github.com/pkgforge-dev) and anylinux team ♥️

I would like to give special thanks to the AppImage AnyLinux gurus who have worked hard to push the AppImage format to the next level, enabling it to run on basically any Linux system and helping to bring Linux application distro fragmentation close to zero. Special shout-out to @fiftydinar, @Samueru-sama, @ivan-hc, @QaidVoid and others. Now this app can run on linux distros as old as when dinosaurs walked earth.
